title: Perception robustness: muse-image-1.0 counterfactual edits (plus local sensor edits), sam-3.1 under two prompt conditions, simulator ground-truth masks

frames.cameras: top for even positions in the seed list, oblique for odd; a seed whose top frame leaves the cup, block or marker under frames_for_seeds' visibility minimum (ground truth only) uses its oblique frame instead; every fallback is listed in inputs.json
frames.made_by: mirror.robustness.frames.frames_for_seeds (executed reference task on sample_layout(seed, 'eval'), segmentation render for masks), run at the inputs stage

instructions.text: Make the scene dimly lit, as if the room lights were turned down to about a third.
Change the lighting to warm, orange-tinted evening light from a tungsten lamp.
Light the scene with one hard spotlight from the upper left so that objects cast sharp, dark shadows.
Replace the table surface and the background with a dark walnut wood tabletop with visible grain.
Make the surroundings look like a cluttered laboratory bench, with tools, cables and papers in the background, but leave the area around the objects clear.
Add a second, unrelated coffee mug standing on the table in the far corner of the image, away from all other objects.
Add a few loose sheets of white paper lying flat on the table in empty areas, not touching or covering any object.
Make the white cup look glossy, like glazed ceramic with bright specular highlights.
Additive Gaussian pixel noise (sigma 12 on a 0-255 scale), fixed seed.

instructions.keep_clause: Keep every object exactly where it is, with the same size, shape and outline, and keep the camera viewpoint and framing unchanged.

A_chooser.procedure: mirror.interpret.sam_prompts.choose_prompts(original frame, 'muse-spark-1.3', kinds=(cup, block, marker), retry=True, verify=False) once per original frame; its accepted phrases are reused for every edit of that frame; an object without an accepted phrase counts as not found

B_fixed.note: colour-free phrases from the plan track, chosen on development frames: 'cube' matched up to 5 objects in a top view, 'small cube' ranked the block first in both frames tried; for the cup, 'open box' and 'small box' both find it but can rank the tray or a box obstacle first (in a one-frame rehearsal 'open box' matched the tray); the tray has no ground-truth mask and is not scored

correction.method: mirror.robustness.geometry.check_geometry fits one whole-frame similarity (scale, shift) per model edit, the editor's drift, and undoes it before segmentation; uncorrected = the edit only resampled to the source size
correction.also_reported: uncorrected scores for condition A (both would pass the SAM cap), and every per-edit correction

measured_path: mirror.robustness.evaluate_robustness (the plan track's function, the same path as its development rehearsal) with conditions A (chooser) and B (fixed), wrapped so that every model request is charged to the caps below; geometry verdicts (kept / weakened / moved / resized / missing / untested) as defined there
local_edits: geometry kept by construction (the same pixels through a known kernel); no correction
plan: 8 ground-truth frames (one per new seed) x 11 frozen instructions (8 by muse-image-1.0, 3 local and deterministic): 64 model edits.
sam-3.1 runs once per phrase on every original and edited frame, under both prompt conditions; its top match is scored against the true visible-pixel mask (the best of all matches is also recorded).

Geometry of each model edit is judged after the whole-frame correction: kept, changed (an object moved, resized or missing) or reframed (no correction brings it into register). Changed and reframed edits are reported in their own groups.
Every frame, instruction and request is reported, including failures.
metrics: IoU of the sam-3.1 mask with the true mask; change from the unedited frame (same condition)
found rate (sam-3.1 returned a mask for the object)
all of the above corrected (primary) and uncorrected, per group, condition and instruction
threshold_scope: objects whose geometry was kept (evaluate_robustness' kept_* summary over all edits: model edits judged kept after correction, plus local edits), corrected scores, evaluated and reported for conditions A and B separately
hypotheses: On edits that keep geometry, sam-3.1 segmentation is stable: median IoU change >= -0.05, found rate >= 0.9 and median centroid error <= 4 px (corrected), under each prompt condition.
dev_run_disclosure: The thresholds were written in the first draft of this design (31 October 2026, before the plan track's development run) and are unchanged. That development run (3 development frames x 11 instructions, results/robustness_dev) and a one-frame rehearsal of this harness were seen before the design was finalised; the frames, prompt conditions and correction rule were chosen after seeing them, the thresholds were not.
inputs_rule: eval samples each seed's layout into this registration's ledger and calls frames_for_seeds; PNG frames and masks listed with sha256 in inputs.json; no model call

audit.result: no seed or input hash of this registration found
